Camila — thanks for the recap and the materials. A couple clarifications from our side so we can triage internally before the Sec review: 

1) Our procurement/security baseline asks are: a) explicit confirmation that PII contained in prompts or model outputs will not be persisted beyond a stated TTL unless we opt in, and b) that audit logs required for compliance (auth/events) are retained for 365 days for our initial contract.

2) Residency: MedIntel must keep PHI/PII in US regions for now. We may later require EU residency for some product lines — please confirm region options and whether the same retention policies apply by region.

3) Technical table: our security team would like a one-page table listing: what is stored by default (prompts, outputs, embeddings, KV cache, session metadata, traces), location (region/default), and TTL. Can you provide that?

4) We’ll need a short written statement for procurement that we can attach to the SOW summarizing default retention behavior (so legal knows what to expect).

Laura — thanks, and looping Priyom to confirm the technical details below. See a concise table and clarifications inline (this is intended to be the one‑pager for your procurement/legal). Let me know if you want this converted to a PDF with company letterhead.

ONE-PAGE SUMMARY (default behaviors and configurable options)
- Prompts (request payload text): Default: transiently buffered in-memory and persisted for 30 days in hosted by default for quality/audit. Configurable: do_not_store flag / privacyMode = true prevents any persistent write (zero-retention). Dedicated/Private deployments can be configured with zero-write policy by default.
- Model outputs (generated text): Default: persisted with prompts for 30 days (same storage class). Configurable: same do_not_store option. Note: streaming responses still go through runtime but are not stored when do_not_store is set.
- Embeddings: Key-value vector stores are only persisted if you call the embeddings-persist endpoint or use our managed vector store. Default API usage does not persist embeddings unless requested.
- KV cache (inference attention cache): Ephemeral, memory-only, destroyed after session; not written to disk in normal operation. For long-running sessions, cache is retained only in-memory per worker.
- Session metadata (request id, model version, latency metrics): Default: retained for 90 days for debugging/analytics on hosted; configurable TTL for Dedicated/Private. Audit logs (auth events, admin actions): Retention options: 365 days (enterprise default), configurable to meet your policy with export hooks to S3 or your logging pipeline.
- Residency: Hosted default region: us-east1. EU region (europe-west1) available for EU-bound data. Private deployments allow on-prem/VPC placement per contract.
- Encryption: All persisted data encrypted at rest with AES-256. Customer-managed KMS supported (Bring-Your-Own-Key) for Dedicated/Private.

Appendix: quick notes
- If MedIntel requires a procurement statement: we can provide a signed confirmation that "Redwood will not persist PII present in prompts or model outputs beyond 30 days for hosted deployments unless explicitly configured to do so by the customer; audit logs will be retained for 365 days under the enterprise SLA unless an alternative retention period is requested in writing." We can add KMS/residency references on request.
- Next steps we propose:
  • Priyom to join the Sec review (can cover encryption / KMS / audit log exports).
  • We provide a short signed memo for procurement (draft in 48 business hours).
  • Schedule security review Wed 2026-11-11 11:00 AM PT (we’ll send a calendar invite if that works).

Cc'ing Priyom for any technical corrections; attaching the SOC2 summary and an annotated data flow diagram to aid the review.

Thanks — Camila
